final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.ordertune, s.n, 1.0 * s.n / step2.total_n AS ratio FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_n IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.ordertune, s.n, s.ratio, s.ratio - step4.avg_ratio AS delta FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s.ratio > step4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(ratio), AVG(delta) FROM step5
